title: STEYX requires at least 3 paired numeric observations (#DIV/0! below 3) and clamps tiny negative SSE residuals to 0
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, STEYX(known_y's, known_x's) pairs observations after checking singletons in formula order and skipping non-numeric positions, requires at least 3 numeric pairs (returning #DIV/0! for 0, 1, or 2 pairs or when sum((x - mean_x)^2) == 0), and computes sqrt((sum_y2 - sum_xy^2 / sum_x2) / (n - 2)), clamping tiny negative floating-point cancellation residuals near 0 to 0 rather than returning #NUM!. Matches 2,858/2,858 full-bank rows.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (row 217) and 2,858/2,858 full-bank STEYX witness rows.

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0.20527.20088 Current Channel, Windows 64-bit (NT 10.0.26200), x86-64, AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, en-ZA
